subject: Renewal planning & capacity uplift — QBR scheduling and SOW prep
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@starlab.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion & capacity planning

Hi Jasmine,

We’re coming up on the contract renewal for Starlab AI (Dec 1), and usage has increased by ~45% quarter-over-quarter. We want to discuss a term extension plus an uplift on committed capacity to cover expected growth and a short-term burst runway for holiday traffic.

Would Redwood be available for a renewal/QBR meeting the week of Oct 18? Primary goals: confirm new committed throughput, review pricing options for multi-quarter staircase, and agree on timeline for an amendment. I’ve attached our internal usage summary and a rough forecast.

Participants on our side: myself (Product), Raj Patel (Engineering), and procurement (procurement@starlab.ai).

Thanks — Claire
Claire Wong
Head of AI Product | Starlab AI
attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (csv)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Claire Wong <claire@starlab.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@starlab.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion & capacity planning

Hi Claire — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth. Happy to kick off a renewal discussion and QBR.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Schedule a 60-min renewal QBR the week of Oct 18 — propose Tue Oct 19 or Wed Oct 20, 10am PT.
- We’ll bring pricing scenarios (stair-step commit, flat uplift, and burst add-on).
- Internal pre-call with Redwood ops + SRE to validate capacity and migration approach.
- Draft amendment / SOW for review (I’ll attach an initial SOW outline).

Internal attendees we plan to include from Redwood: David Kim (Customer Solutions / capacity forecasting), Kimberly Park (Pricing & contracts), and Marissa Cole (Customer Success / exec sponsor).

I’ve attached a short SOW outline and a sample QBR agenda to get us started. If that looks OK, confirm which day/time works best and we’ll send a calendar invite + pre-read.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW_Starlab_v2.pdf (draft), QBR-Agenda-Starlab.xlsx

Date: 2026-10-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — Starlab renewal: pre-call + tasking (Oct 12)

Team — looping you in on the Starlab renewal. Claire flagged a large usage uptick and wants a QBR week of Oct 18. I’m proposing an internal pre-call on Oct 12 to align materials.

Quick ask list:
- David: can you run capacity headroom and PV estimates for their current model mix (low-latency chat + embeddings)? Need a 6/12/24 week forecast and suggested reserved GPUs.
- Kimberly: please prepare three commercial scenarios (stair-step commits, fixed uplift, and month-to-month burst add-on) including unit economics and potential discounts at each tier.
- Marissa: please draft an exec one-pager and invite list for the QBR (product + eng + procurement). We should aim for an exec slot for Raj + Claire plus a 30-min ops block.

Internal pre-call: Oct 12, 9:30am PT (30m). I’ll book a quick MURAL board for the run-of-show.

Thanks — Jasmine
